💪 Build: Bodybuilder Build

Bodybuilder Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Bodybuilder frame — extreme muscle mass visible everywhere, deeply defined separation between muscle groups, prominent veins. The body reads as sculpted to maximum size. Female: shoulders broad with muscle while the waist stays drawn in, neck thick but short, jaw soft under the mass, the chest line still reading female over the muscle, waist drawn in. Male: shoulders and neck massive, jaw heavy and square, a slab chest with no waist taper. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at extreme mass.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
